title: What is the pattern here?
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: When you love something, how far do you take it?
I said the chapter is about land. The author gets an obsession to buy land.
I read the author's opening line.
when I enjoy something. I have a tendency to overdo it.
What is the pattern here with him, I asked? A student said: he goes all in. He really commits.

groups.heading: As entrepreneurs, we have obsessive personalities

lines.text: I relate a lot to this, I said, and so do other friends. As entrepreneurs we kind of have obsessive personalities. I'm saying that in a good and a bad way. The bad is that in those obsessions we take risks. We can be extremely hallucinogenic, where we twist our imagination into what we want our reality to be.
I told how the author became obsessed with bringing a nearly extinct animal back, and, as I retell it, now has tens of thousands of them roaming his ranches, and sells the meat to fund it.

People throw the word sustainable around all the time, I said, and I kind of laugh, because people are very hypocritical. What does it exactly mean? A student said: you are producing more than you are selling.
Another said: you are not deteriorating the land. It serves you now and it serves future generations. I said: so you are not depleting a resource you cannot get back.
I said the author sells the meat and puts the money back into the ranches, to increase the herd and the habitat. It has its ups and downs, I said. He realized he had an overgrazing problem.
What would a sustainable version of your obsession look like?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write something you do all in.
Write the good side and the bad side of that obsession.
Write how you would define sustainable for it: not depleting what you cannot get back.
Write where the money for it comes from, and where it goes back in.
Write the first sign that you are overdoing it.

check.q: What did a student say the author's pattern is?
How did I describe entrepreneurs' personalities?
choices: Kind of obsessive, in a good and a bad way

check.q: What did a student say sustainable means for land?
choices: It serves you now and future generations

recap: Know your obsession, its good and bad sides, and what keeps it sustainable.
